given: the home screen stock table is shown with at least one stock record
when: the warehouse operator scans the quantity column
then: the quantity values are right-aligned within their column

independence.rationale: AC1 verifies the correct SKU/location/quantity values appear in rows; AC2 verifies only the right-alignment of the quantity column, which can be broken (left-aligned) while AC1 stays green, and vice versa

architectural_notes: E2E, but purely a client presentation concern: right-alignment of the quantity column lives entirely in the React SPA home table component (client/), with no server, service, or repository involvement — the boundary contract is unchanged. Cross-cutting concern is UI formatting, owned by the client presentation layer, never the domain. Verified by a client component test asserting the quantity cells carry the right-aligned style; no branch DB interaction is needed for this assertion.
